title: Strapless Ruffle Tulle Mermaid Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Strapless Ruffle Tulle Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Strapless mermaid maternity photoshoot gown with a gathered tulle bust and a tiered ruffled tulle skirt with train. US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a strapless mermaid gown that shows off your bump, with a gathered tulle bust and a dramatic skirt of tiered, ruffled tulle that flows out into a long train.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
strapless sweetheart neckline with a gathered tulle bust, a smooth fitted bodice, and a mermaid skirt of tiered ruffled tulle with a train.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Spot clean or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot. This is a fitted style: choose by your bust and hips, and if you are between sizes, consider the larger one.
garment_lock: a strapless maternity gown in a mermaid shape: a smooth, fitted bodice with a gathered, twisted sweetheart bust of fine tulle, shaped over the bump and hips, flaring at the knee into a very full skirt of tiered, ruffled tulle that spreads into a long train

image_prompt:
DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The attached images are the exact reference for ONE Shopify listing: a maternity photoshoot gown, "Strapless Ruffle Tulle Mermaid Maternity Photoshoot Gown", in SKY BLUE (a soft cornflower-leaning light blue).
The gown (ref1 full length, ref2 and ref3 the same gown): a strapless maternity gown in a mermaid shape: a smooth, fitted bodice with a gathered, twisted sweetheart bust of fine tulle, shaped over the bump and hips, flaring at the knee into a very full skirt of tiered, ruffled tulle that spreads into a long train. The bodice and the tulle are the same sky blue.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light backdrop and sheer white curtain, wearing this gown, one hand on her bump, the other resting at her side; full length, front-facing, the ruffled tulle skirt and train spread on the floor, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a meadow at golden hour, the ruffled tulle train spread behind her; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, the tiered ruffled tulle skirt spread around the base, showing the strapless gathered bust and fitted mermaid shape clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: soft sky blue colour, strapless sweetheart neckline with gathered tulle bust, smooth fitted mermaid bodice, voluminous tiered ruffled tulle skirt with a long train. No sleeves, no straps, no logos, no letters, no extra embellishment, no belt, no sequins.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
